Sections.Name: Population
Sections.Description: Generic Advanced NPCs: townsfolk, and people in dungeons, buildings and the wilderness made from generic templates.

Keys.Name: GenericPeople
Keys.Description: Same people every visit: each town keeps its generic NPCsand what happens to them is saved.Random each visit: re-rolled whenever a town loads;nothing about them is saved.

Keys.Name: MaxGenericPerTown
Keys.Description: Most generic NPCs in one town or one building (0 turns them off).

Keys.Name: Dungeons
Keys.Description: Generic ANPCs with a "dungeons" spawn block appear in dungeons.

Keys.Name: Interiors
Keys.Description: Generic ANPCs with an "interiors" spawn block appear in taverns,guild halls, temples, shops and houses.

Keys.Name: Wilderness
Keys.Description: Generic ANPCs with a "wilderness" spawn block appeararound you in the wilderness.

Keys.Name: MaxWildernessAround
Keys.Description: Most wilderness ANPCs around you at once (0 turns them off).

Sections.Name: Companions
Sections.Description: Recruitment limits and catch-up for hired ANPC companions.

Keys.Name: MaxFollowers
Keys.Description: Maximum hired companions, including those waiting elsewhere.Escort NPCs with no_companion_slot do not count.Lowering this limit keeps your existing party.Unlimited parties may reduce performance.

Keys.Name: CatchUpDistance
Keys.Description: Metres a following companion may fall behind before it catches up.It reappears close to you, behind you if possible, on a spot you cannot see.It also catches up after 5 seconds farther than 6 m without closing in.Waiting, fighting or fleeing companions never catch up.

Keys.Name: DisableFollowerBarks
Keys.Description: Disable follower barks.Silences cm_ companion speech and hides the individual bark option.Combat voices and footsteps keep their own settings.

Sections.Name: Corpses
Sections.Description: Bodies of ANPCs with their own sprite sets.

Keys.Name: DeathAnimation
Keys.Description: Play the death animation before the body lies still.Off: the body appears at once, as in vanilla Daggerfall.

Keys.Name: DirectionalCorpses
Keys.Description: A body on its last death frame keeps showing the side you see it from.Off: it shows its front or back and always faces you, like vanilla corpses.

Keys.Name: ANPCSounds
Keys.Description: ANPC: each ANPC's own Sounds folder, Daggerfall's voice where it has none.Vanilla: Daggerfall's voice for every ANPC.Off: ANPCs make no voice sounds.

Keys.Name: StepsVolume
Keys.Description: Volume of ANPC footsteps, in percent of the sound volume.
